text: {"lessons":["Selling winners quickly can reduce exposure to further gains; I should consider each stock’s prospects rather than reacting only to its past rise.","Holding losers without reassessing them can let problems persist; I should review the reasons for owning every position, including stocks that have fallen.","My recent trades have not prevented modest portfolio fluctuations, so I should trade deliberately, keep a suitable cash reserve, and review the whole portfolio periodically."]}
